factor_name: VIX Shock and Cross-Asset Dispersion 3-Day Reversal

calculation.expression: -(3-day cumulative return), activated when lagged VIX pct-change exceeds its trailing 60-day 75th percentile AND lagged cross-asset return dispersion exceeds its trailing 60-day 75th percentile; cross-sectional median demean
calculation.description: During jointly elevated volatility shock and cross-asset dispersion, rank assets by lagged three-day reversal. All activation inputs are shifted one trading day to prevent look-ahead. VIX is observation-only and is never traded.

validation.regime_notes: Daily admission gate passed, but the activated sample is sparse and regime dependent: 2020-2022 IC -0.0952 over 12 dates, 2023-2024 +0.0894 over 11 dates, 2025-2026 +0.1110 over 15 dates, and 2027 +0.2073 over 1 date. Interpret uncertainty conservatively.
validation.validation_method: Cross-sectional Spearman correlation between point-in-time signal and next-day forward return; dates require at least 8 valid tradable instruments.
